{
  "assessments": [
    {
      "clause_id": "k1",
      "rule_id": "R06",
      "verdict": "violation",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "evidence": "All user records and transaction histories are retained indefinitely within our archival databases",
      "reason": "Retaining records indefinitely violates the requirement to destroy personal data once it is no longer necessary."
    },
    {
      "clause_id": "k3",
      "rule_id": "R05",
      "verdict": "violation",
      "confidence": 0.95,
      "evidence": "requests for profile purging or record adjustments are subject to administrative review without guarantee of execution",
      "reason": "Making data subject rights subject to administrative discretion without guarantee violates the right to access, correct, and delete data."
    },
    {
      "clause_id": "k4",
      "rule_id": "R01",
      "verdict": "compliant",
      "confidence": 0.8,
      "evidence": "This agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the substantive laws",
      "reason": "Choice of law clause does not directly violate consent rules under the PDPL."
    },
    {
      "clause_id": "k5",
      "rule_id": "R01",
      "verdict": "compliant",
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "evidence": "Users may terminate their account agreement at any time by submitting a formal closure request",
      "reason": "Allowing account termination and settling financial obligations complies with general contractual terms and does not breach consent withdrawal."
    },
    {
      "clause_id": "k6",
      "rule_id": "R01",
      "verdict": "compliant",
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "evidence": "Certain operational activities may be executed without explicit user authorization where such processing is strictly necessary",
      "reason": "Processing without explicit consent is permitted when necessary for contractual obligations or legitimate legal grounds under the PDPL."
    },
    {
      "clause_id": "k8",
      "rule_id": "R02",
      "verdict": "violation",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "evidence": "reserves the right to utilize all collected information for any business purpose deemed appropriate by the management",
      "reason": "Using collected data for 'any purpose' decided by management violates the principle of purpose limitation."
    }
  ]
}
